hooks.command: for root in "${PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${DEVIN_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; do if [ -n "$root" ] && [ -f "$root/bin/hook.py" ]; then exec python3 -B "$root/bin/hook.py" SessionStart; fi; done; if command -v ox-vibesec-hook >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec ox-vibesec-hook SessionStart; fi; printf '%s\n' 'ox-vibesec: plugin root not found' >&2; exit 0
